searchText: Hi all, quick and simple suggestion: if an EIP requires another EIP, could these EIPs have URLs to the other EIPs? 🙂 There is already a requires section, see EIP1 > requires: EIP number(s) (Optional field) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1#eip-formats-and-templates The EIP website then links to the required EIPs.
